builder: Builder reads AGENTS.md, design/README.md, design/, and tests/ before changing code, then names project-local governance evidence in the handoff.
inspector: Inspector must verify AGENTS.md, design/README.md, design/, and tests/ obligations against the result, and mark skipped governance as Weak, Unproven, or Blocking.
gatekeeper: GateKeeper treats skipped AGENTS.md, design/README.md, design/, or tests/ responsibilities as Weak, Unproven, or Blocking before closure.
default: Respect project-local governance when AGENTS.md, design/README.md, design/, or tests/ apply.
